title: There is an elephant in the room: TOWARDS A CRITIQUE ON THE USE OF FAIRNESS IN BIOMETRICS
reasoning: The paper provides a critical analysis of the concept of fairness and ethical discourses within the field of biometrics, specifically in the context of migration control. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks; instead, it critiques the focus on ethical/fairness metrics as a distraction from underlying political and historical injustices.
